trust_decision.summary: A request header block must carry at most one Host field, and a Host value must match :authority when both are present; decided by the single shared validator src/h2/utilities.py:428-473, which is reached from both the inbound pipeline (src/h2/utilities.py:213-215) and the outbound pipeline (src/h2/utilities.py:699-702).

landing_point.why: It is the only code that reads b"host" out of a request header block, and the TODO at src/h2/utilities.py:443-444 names this exact gap (duplicate Host on receive, duplicate headers on send), so an engineer reading the advisory summary lands here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: H2Connection.receive_data (inbound request/PUSH_PROMISE header blocks, via Stream._process_received_headers), H2Connection.send_headers (outbound request headers), H2Connection.push_stream (outbound PUSH_PROMISE request headers)
fix_sites.module_kind: core protocol library / header-validation pipeline (shared helper used by both the inbound and outbound wrappers)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The code itself exempts trailer blocks in both wrappers (src/h2/utilities.py:486-491 and 597-602, with the docstring at src/h2/utilities.py:430-431 saying "a request block that isn't a trailer"), and outbound normalization/validation are documented default-on toggles (src/h2/config.py:174-178), so a solver can argue the advisory covers only the inbound request header section and that the remaining paths are intentional, documented exclusions.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Duplicate cookie field lines are legitimate: normalize_outbound_headers splits one cookie value into many cookie headers (src/h2/utilities.py:630-649, enabled at src/h2/utilities.py:663-664) before validation runs (src/h2/utilities.py:699-702), so a fix that rejects any repeated regular header inside _validate_host_authority_header breaks split outbound cookies; likewise h2 deliberately accepts repeated content-length only when the values are equal (src/h2/stream.py:1382-1386), which a blanket duplicate-header rule would also reject.

O6_input_shapes: two or more b"host" fields with no :authority present (previously accepted silently, now ProtocolError)
duplicate b"host" alongside a matching :authority (previously the mismatch check saw only the last value)
duplicate b"host" alongside a mismatched :authority (now the duplicate error fires first)
the repeated host field placed before or after the pseudo-header block / other regular fields
the same repeated-host shape on the outbound send path, where header names have already been lowercased by normalization (src/h2/utilities.py:662)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A request stream's trailer block (second HEADERS frame with END_STREAM) may carry one or more b"host" fields; _check_host_authority_header skips every host/authority check when is_trailer is set, and _reject_pseudo_header_fields only rejects pseudo-headers in trailers (src/h2/utilities.py:374), so a Host in the trailer section reaches TrailersReceived.headers with no duplicate or mismatch check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Trailers are a separate header block, the docstring and both wrappers explicitly say the check applies only to request header blocks that are not trailers, and RFC 9113 only forbids pseudo-headers in trailers, so the exemption reads as deliberate.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function; public route H2Connection.receive_data -> Stream.receive_headers (src/h2/stream.py:1065-1107) -> Stream._process_received_headers (src/h2/stream.py:1347-1348)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Outbound request headers with normalize_outbound_headers=False: validate_outbound_headers never lowercases names (src/h2/stream.py:1296-1307), so a mixed-case b"Host" plus a lowercase b"host" slips past the exact b"host" comparison at src/h2/utilities.py:451 and, with no :authority, emits two Host field lines with no error.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Sent headers are the application's own choice, normalization is a documented default-on toggle (src/h2/config.py:175), and the advisory is about what a server accepts, not what an h2 client emits.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: caller side of the same sink, one file away (stream.py -> utilities.py)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Give _check_sent_host_authority_header its own duplicate-Host check instead of delegating to the shared validator, so the send path and the receive path each carry a copy of the rule.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The two wrappers already exist as separate functions with near-identical bodies, so a maintainer fixing a server-side smuggling report would plausibly write the new rule in the inbound wrapper only and leave the outbound one untouched.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Lift the trailer exemption into a trailer-specific rule: reject host (and any authority-bearing field) in trailer blocks rather than skipping validation there.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The surrounding comment enumerates exactly which block kinds are exempt; the natural hardening move is to add one more clause to that same skip, not to touch the validator.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Reject repeated content-length even when the values are identical, as a companion duplicate-framing-field rule to the duplicate-Host rule.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the same mechanism (a trusted framing header appearing twice) handled a few files away in the stream, and it is already a partial check that only compares values.

O9_family: HTTP request smuggling via inconsistent request interpretation / duplicate request-framing header fields (CWE-444)

O10_build.toolchain: setuptools>=82 + wheel with pyproject.toml src/ layout; requires-python >=3.10; runtime deps hyperframe>=6.1,<7 and hpack>=4.2,<5; tests via pytest>=8.3.3 with pytest-xdist, pytest-cov and hypothesis; tox drives py310-py314 plus lint (ruff, mypy --strict) and a separate h2spec env
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_invalid_headers.py covers this exact area: TestFilter (line 423) parametrizes both h2.utilities.validate_headers and validate_outbound_headers over all HeaderValidationFlags combinations, TestInvalidFrameSequences carries the host/:authority mismatch case ("host", "notexample.com") at line 46 and the trailer idiom at lines 199-212, and test_headers_event_skipping_validation (line 149) documents that validate_inbound_headers=False lets every invalid block through.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the duplicate-Host raise to the inbound wrapper _check_host_authority_header (or reject any repeated header name), which leaves the send path and the trailer block unguarded and breaks legitimately split outbound cookie fields.
